item.title: McDermott awarded EPCIC contract by PETRONAS
item.description: McDermott has secured a subsea contract from PETRONAS Carigali Brunei Ltd for EPCIC of a natural gas development project offshore Brunei Darussalam.

item.title: Galveston LNG Bunker Port signs agreement for LNG bunker fuel
item.description: Galveston LNG Bunker Port has executed a heads of agreement with an international shipping company for the supply of LNG bunker fuel.

item.title: Edison signs contract with Knutsen
item.description: Edison has signed a contract with shipowner Knutsen OAS Shipping for the long-term charter of an LNG carrier.

item.title: Wood wins maintenance contract for Rio Grande LNG facility
item.description: John Wood Group PLC has secured a 10-year contract with NextDecade to deliver maintenance solutions at Rio Grande LNG in the US.

item.title: Europe’s first cruise LNG dry-dock completed
item.description: Lloyd’s Register, Carnival UK, and Carnival Cruise Line have completed Europe’s first major LNG dry-docks for large passenger vessels.

item.title: MVM ONEnergy and SOCAR sign natural gas supply agreement
item.description: SOCAR and MVM ONEnergy have signed a new natural gas supply agreement commencing from 1 January 2026.

item.title: TechnipFMC awarded contract for Chevron’s Gorgon Stage 3 project
item.description: TechnipFMC has been awarded a contract for Subsea 2.0® production systems by Chevron for the Gorgon Stage 3 brownfield project.

item.title: Alfa Laval launches FCM LNG fuel supply system
item.description: Alfa Laval has announced the launch of a new fuel supply solution FCM LNG for LNG-powered vessels.

item.title: Ovintiv enters into agreement for Cedar LNG capacity
item.description: Ovintiv Inc. and a subsidiary of Pembina Pipeline Corp. has announced the signing of a 12-year agreement for 0.5 million tpy of Pembina's liquefaction capacity at the Cedar LNG facility.

item.title: SEA-LNG welcomes UK P&I Club
item.description: SEA-LNG has announced that UK P&I Club has joined its growing membership.
